patch_list: Lets Google Contacts sign in to your Google account through microG instead of Play services, so contacts sync, Phenotype and push work on a de-Googled phone. Every Play services name the app uses is pointed at microG's, and microG is told…

Makes the dark theme pure black: the window, contact lists and cards become #000000, while dialogs and menus stay near-black so they remain visible. Applies to both the default palette and "Use system colors". Turn on dark mode to see it.
